Dsup.claim_boundary: analogy only; software behavior does not reproduce Dsup biochemistry
Dsup.engineering_analogy: integrity shielding: hashes, immutable checkpoints, redundant validation
Dsup.evidence_role: radiation-associated DNA protection in biological systems

SAHS_CAHS.claim_boundary: analogy only; resource dormancy is not biological anhydrobiosis
SAHS_CAHS.engineering_analogy: dormancy: freeze mutable state and reduce operation to a minimal survival set

recovery.claim_boundary: engineering analogy/design principle, not a biological equivalence claim
recovery.engineering_analogy: fail-closed recovery gates before resuming full execution
recovery.evidence_role: return from extreme-stress survival states requires restored conditions

supports: SAHS protection of biological structures during desiccation
local transient Dsup expression reduced radiation damage in mouse tissues
